_comment: Exp 6 ground truth for Markdown-aware chunking quality. 24 queries: 12 heading-targeted, 8 general, 4 cross-domain. expected_section is the H2 (or H1 if no H2) the gold chunk lives under in the source document.

queries.query: Under Getting Started in the Nuxt readme, what command creates a new starter project?
In the Vue Development section of the Nuxt readme, what helper sets the page title?
Under Professional Support in the Nuxt readme, who handles technical audit and consulting?
Under Option Stores in the Pinia docs, what shape does the state factory return?
In the Setup Stores section of Pinia, what does a ref become inside the store?
Under Destructuring from a Store in Pinia, which helper preserves reactivity?
In the Pinia 'What syntax should I pick' section, what does the doc recommend for choosing between option and setup stores?
queries.expected_answer: pick the one that you feel the most comfortable

What features does Nuxt provide for full-stack web applications?
How does Pinia define a store and what is the unique id for?
Why does the RAG essay argue hybrid retrieval is the obvious response to dense-only failure modes?
queries.expected_answer: Run a sparse retriever and a dense retriever in parallel
